product.description: NutriHarvest Brown Rice 1kg offers a pure, non-GMO grain harvested from sustainably managed paddies. The rice is milled to retain the bran and germ, delivering a nutty flavor and a chewy texture ideal for pilafs, risottos, and side dishes. Packaged in a resealable, recyclable paper pouch, the product maintains freshness and extends shelf life up to 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place. The 1‑kilogram bag provides a generous portion for families or meal‑prep enthusiasts, supporting a balanced diet rich in fiber and essential minerals. No artificial additives or preservatives are used, making it suitable for health‑conscious consumers and those following gluten‑free or low‑sodium meal plans.
